name: Recipe Box
description: The family recipe collection for a space. Collaborators store recipes with a photo, ingredients, steps, servings, tags and notes, then cook from a clean recipe-card view; search and tag filters keep a growing box easy to browse. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is published to, gets a live read-only view. Recipes are the space's own recipes table (recipes.table.jsonl), synced with the space, so a Meal Planner in the same space picks from the same recipes.
